finding.headline: "Family Meals Fell Apart (Everyone Eats Differently)"
finding.problem: "The baby eats purée, the 4-year-old eats noodles, my husband wants jollof and I eat nothing. We don't sit as a family anymore."
finding.person: Mum of 4+2 whose family dinners collapsed into everyone snacking; husband complains, in-laws judge (Care.com).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (one-pot family-meal system for new-mum households)". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
